source: Sentinel-1 radar (Copernicus), 620 passes 2018-01-17 to 2026-10-13; JRC Global Surface Water 1984-2021; MERIT Hydro HAND
note: share_flooded_1km = share of flood-prone ground within 1 km (no permanent water, no high ground) that radar saw as unusually wet on that pass. Radar under-detects water between buildings. HAND = height above nearest drainage; under ~5 m is flood-prone.
